rounding.title: Rounding
rounding.hint: Rounding applies per project, task and day, never per entry.

clients.title: Clients
clients.lead: Clients with address and invoice details. Projects and rates are on each client's page.
clients.archiveText: The client leaves the list and cannot be restored here. Projects, booked time and rates are kept.
clients.deleteText: A client without projects and rates is deleted for good. If projects or rates still refer to it, it stays in the records as locked, a restriction of processing under Art. 18 DSGVO (GDPR). You may have to confirm your sign-in again first.

firstRun.title: No clients yet
firstRun.text: Project time is always booked on a project, and every project belongs to a client.

client.restrictedText: Locked under Art. 18 DSGVO (GDPR): the details stay in the records, the client can no longer be chosen anywhere.
client.name: Name
client.countryHint: Two-letter country code, such as DE, AT or NL
client.paymentTermsHint: In days. Leave empty for the general default.

projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Project
projects.budgetHint: Hours, such as 40 or 37:30. Leave empty for no budget. A warning shows from 80%.
projects.empty: No projects for this client yet
projects.emptyHint: Time can only be booked once the client has a project.
projects.allArchived: All projects of this client are archived.

members.title: Who books on the project
members.openHint: Everyone with a personnel record can book on the project.
members.closedHint: Only the members and HR can book on the project.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lead: Split up the project. Without a setting of its own, a task takes over whether the project is billable.
tasks.name: Task
tasks.archiveText: The task can no longer be chosen and cannot be restored here. Booked time and rates are kept.
tasks.empty: No tasks. Time is booked on the project itself.

rates.title: Rates

lead.default: Applies when no more specific rate fits the client, project, task or person.
lead.client: Apply to all projects of this client unless the project or task has a rate of its own.
lead.project: The most specific rate applies: task before project before client, a rate for one person before the one for everyone.

rates.formHint: A rate is never changed, a new one with a later valid-from date takes over. It applies to all unbilled time from that day on.
rates.amountHint: Net per hour, such as 95 or 95.50
rates.deleteText: The rate has not taken effect yet. Without it, the previous rate stays in force from that day on.

empty.client: No rate of its own, the default rate applies.
empty.project: No rate of its own, the client's rate or the default rate applies.
